name: Carla Puig
summary: Principal Machine Learning Engineer with 16 years of experience designing and scaling production-grade ML systems across logistics, SaaS, and cybersecurity. Expert in building deep learning architectures, optimizing high-throughput inference engines, and leading technical strategy for cross-functional platform teams. Proven track record of translating complex algorithmic research into substantial infrastructure cost savings and operational efficiencies.

experience.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
experience.description: Architected and deployed a PyTorch-based real-time courier dispatch routing optimization system serving 2M daily active orders. Reduced average delivery latency by 14% and computing infrastructure costs by $1.2M annually utilizing auto-scaling Kubernetes clusters and optimized Docker containers. Led technical strategy for 3 cross-functional ML platform teams totaling 18 engineers.

experience.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
experience.description: Designed and implemented Deep Learning models for automated form generation and semantic conversion optimization, improving form completion rates by 8.5%. Built the core Python-based ML training pipeline from scratch, managing a throughput of 50M API requests daily. Scaled the serving infrastructure on AWS using Docker, reducing model training cycle times from days to under 4 hours.

experience.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
experience.description: Developed Computer Vision algorithms for automated trademark and copyright infringement detection across 100 online marketplaces. Built deep learning image classification models that identified fraudulent listings with 99.2% accuracy, reducing manual review volume by 65%. Automated image preprocessing pipelines using Python, scaling throughput to handle over 10M images daily.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer
experience.description: Implemented early Machine Learning and predictive algorithms for HR document parsing and categorization, reducing manual data entry for clients by 40%. Built backend Python services to support high-throughput document processing pipelines. Maintained and optimized database queries to reduce application response latency by 250ms.
